name: lez-faucet
description: Request one fixed testnet drop for a public LEZ account you already own, on either LEZ testnet: 150 LEZ from the on-chain Piñata on the legacy testnet (v0.2.4), or 0.1 LEZ from a hosted claim service on the v0.3 testnet. The app holds no account, asks for no secret, and stores nothing.
